measurement_scope: Read-only audit of retained calls-only traces and B1 collector/reader code. No LeWM process was started.

observed_archive.capture_scope_limit: One process plus newly profiled threads; native calls, child processes, and already-running threads are not complete.

existing_offline_analysis_budgets.reference_observation_note: The older call analysis recorded 1,386,048 reference observations; the default 1,000,000 reference ceiling was insufficient, so replay used 2,000,000.

collector_default.max_references: same ceiling as shared base weak-reference issuer; archive base default was 8192

b1_limits.counting: Collector max_events counts every INSTRUCTION, CALL_ATTEMPT, ENTRY_HANDSHAKE, and GAP row. max_loads is per instruction. Collector max_references is the shared live weak-reference table ceiling, not an aggregate sidecar-occurrence limit. Reader max_loads and max_references count all decoded load occurrences and all non-null reference fields across the sidecar; duplicate reference fields count separately.
b1_limits.reader_budget_scope: Reader max_raw_bytes/max_lines bound decompressed operand sidecars and metadata. The original v1 frame trace has a separate frame budget; the retained retry archive needs at least 256,000,000 bytes for that input.
b1_limits.cap_effect: On event/byte/per-record-size overflow the collector records a drop and stops. The reader preserves a collection-gap issue. The route engine marks that process bad and rejects every attempt from that process with CAPTURE_GAP; a partial prefix is diagnostic only. Per-lookup namespace gaps are narrower and invalidate only route windows that cross them.

assessment.inference: The retained 25-step calls-only run has 84,319 frame invocations, while the B1 default allows 100,000 total rows including every executed project-code instruction plus call/entry/gap rows. This is not an observed B1 event count, but it is no evidence that the default can cover that run; the total is likely too small for a complete sidecar.
assessment.recommendation: Treat 100,000 events/32 MB as a bounded instrumentation pilot, not a proven full-run setting. A route-producing capture must finish with zero dropped events, errors, I/O failures, and previous-profile chaining. No archived per-instruction trace supports a numeric full-LeWM budget yet. For a useful bounded first route attempt, shorten the inference workload (for example eval.eval_budget=1) and keep a hard cap; accept route analysis only after clean metadata and reader-budget fit. If using a larger cap, raise the postprocessing operand event/load/reference/raw-byte/line ceilings together and retain the original frame trace ceiling of at least 256 MB. The shortened workload is a proposal, not a verified fit.
